audit.whatIsWrong: Overall winrate is 46.97% (Sona slightly favored) but content.win[] gave Milio 5 of 7 stages, and the packet itself flags this as contradicting the data.
audit.why: full.phases[3/5/6].side already read Skill/Sona/Sona (matching the real winrate story) but content win[3],win[5],win[6] still read Milio/Skill/Milio — the two layers disagreed on three rows.
audit.corrected: Moved win[3]->Skill, win[5]->Sona, win[6]->Sona to match the already-correct full.side values, and rewrote whys[3,5,6] plus the mid/late prose to match.

audit.why: Spikes (level 2, level 6 Crescendo, first item sustain, late teamfight) are already covered in breakdown.spikes and spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions: Sona's Aria (W) antiheal timing, the Power Chord/Hymn of Valor auto-reset tell, and Hymn of Valor's on-hit scaling were not stated.
audit.why: All three are real Riot-text-derived facts the brief flagged as applicable but absent.
audit.corrected: Folded antiheal (named Aria) into itemization and the auto-reset tell into Key Ability Interactions. On-hit scaling had no safe slot without breaking the length band or exceeding the report-entry cap — recorded in notes instead of fabricating a new field.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your E haste lets you dodge her poke while you out-sustain her.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it's skill-based: your E haste helps you dodge her poke, but her aura stacking closes the gap.

edits.before: At first item the fight stays skill-dependent as both of you scale into sustain.
edits.after: At first item Sona's Aria/aura sustain and Crescendo threat start to outpace your fire, tilting lane to her.

edits.before: Late your R cleanse and global heals let your team outlast Sona's auras.
edits.after: Late, Sona's global aura value and Crescendo teamfighting edge out your single-target cleanse and heals.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 still favour you as your W ramps and your E haste lets you dodge her skillshot-less but predictable poke, but level 6 flips to even because Crescendo is a longer, harder lock than your ult can answer. Respect the all-in whenever her R is up, and ward the flanks so she can't curve a Crescendo into your backline.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 turn skill-based: your W ramps and E haste help you dodge her poke, but her aura stacking closes the gap, and level 6 stays even because Crescendo is a longer, harder lock than your ult can answer. Respect the all-in whenever her R is up, and ward the flanks so she can't curve a Crescendo into your backline.

edits.before: With your first item and beyond your sustained double-heals and the R cleanse tip the sustained fight back to you: you simply out-heal Sona's shields and can peel her burst combo off your carry. Group with your team so your ult's global reach outvalues her single-target auras.
edits.after: From first item on, Sona's aura stacking and Crescendo threat start to outpace your fire: her shields and stun-lock chain now tip sustained fights her way unless you play around R's cooldown. Group tight and save your cleanse for Crescendo, not chip damage.

edits.before: You delete CC comps: R the chain, W the range war, and warm the carry through the burst.
edits.after: Sona's late aura stacking and Crescendo edge fights her way — bank R strictly for the chain.

edits.before: - Milio vs Sona - Track: Sona Crescendo. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Crescendo is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.
edits.after: - Milio vs Sona - Track: Sona Crescendo. - Track her engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - The duo goes when Crescendo is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: Two E charges buy trade insurance — hold one for her Power Chord proc, not both on random chip.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Trading blind past her Aria heal window ignores your burn ledger — stacked burn wins races, not heals.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Sona Crescendo, 100-140s CD: matchup-defining — the stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. Tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Track Sona’s Crescendo: The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Sona’s Crescendo, and watch for the Power Chord auto-reset — the empowered auto is your step-back cue, not the ability cast.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early against her Aria heals.

edits.before: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on his engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.
edits.after: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on her engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.

notes: Level chart had a real disagreement: full.phases[3/5/6].side already read Skill/Sona/Sona while content.win[3/5/6] read Milio/Skill/Milio. The packet's own defects list flags this exact contradiction (46.97% overall winrate vs a chart giving Milio 5/7 stages), so I trusted the already-corrected full layer and moved win[]+whys[] to match it rather than the other way around — this is a judgment call (Medium confidence), not a kit-certain fact, so flagging it here. suspectNames flagged 'Sona's Aria of Perseverance' as a possible misname, but that IS the correct W name per enemyAbilities — false positive, no fix needed. onhit-itemization missing interaction (Hymn of Valor scales with attack speed) had no safe slot within the length band / 2-report-edit cap without cutting something else; left unaddressed, recorded here for a future pass. Fixed 3 MISGENDER hits, 2 COPY_PASTE_BLEED bleeds, and the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT hit (added Sona's real R cooldown 100-140s).
